reviews.text:
Hailey, Kiki, Dr Adam and the rest of the staff here were all amazing during my cats dental extraction today. Naturally it is extremely nerve wracking having to take your pet in for any medical procedure especially when it involves anesthesia, but the team updated me every step of the way which made the whole experience much less scary. Hailey sat with me before bringing him in and explained in detail everything that was about happen so that I was fully informed and could make educated decisions on what to do. I did not feel like I was guessing or left in the dark about anything. When in the procedure, Dr Adam called me multiple times during to update me and allow me to help with decisions along the way. It was clear the level of care, consideration and professionalism they all put into my lil man and that made me feel extremely reassured the whole time. (Which is so important if you know how freaky this kind of thing can feel as a cat mom.)

I was given detailed notes on everything that had happened and what the next steps would be. The reception team was also very helpful and reassuring. My kitty came back clearly well taken care of and calm and peaceful. The whole experience definitely put my mind at ease regarding any medical care that might be needed for my kitties. I am extremely confident that my baby was in good hands. Will be back again for sure. Thanks so much team!
We took our very scared kitty here for her first vet visit and they were great! Clean, welcoming clinic, transparent pricing, great staff! They took wonderful care of our little girl!

I cannot say enough great things about Juno Main and the care they provided for our puppy.

Our puppy became quite sick, and despite it being close to the end of the day, they squeezed us in just 30 minutes before closing. Dr. Kaufmanis and her team took their time assessing him and never made us feel rushed. They were incredibly kind and made sure he was as comfortable as possible throughout the visit.

When it became clear that he needed to go to the emergency hospital, Dr. Kaufmanis went above and beyond. She contacted a couple of ERs to find out which one could see our puppy sooner and provided a handover directly to the ER team. The ER visit was understandably stressful for us, but having that communication already in place made the transition so much more seamless and smooth. We didn’t have to start from the beginning or explain everything again when we arrived.

I’m also quite sure the Juno team ended up staying late to make sure our puppy was properly taken care of and safely transferred to the next level of care. We really, really appreciated that.

Our puppy is doing much better now, and we’re incredibly grateful to Dr. Kaufmanis and the entire Juno Main team for taking such good care of him when he needed it most. Thank you so much!

In summary because this ended up very long: I believe Juno and Dr. Avitan are hands down the best vet I could ask for as a nervous pet owner. They are like SHOCKINGLY communicative and 100% transparent when it comes to treatment plans and pricing breakdowns. Even without the virtual care subscription, I can chat with a team member 24/7 so if I have a question about an appointment, a medication, treatment plan etc. (even in the middle of the night), I can get a response within a couple of minutes. Not only that, but they'll actually message ME to check on my pets!

For the full story:
My dog had heart disease. Which, as you might expect, requires some vet intervention. For years we would take her from clinic to clinic to clinic and would always leave feeling like she wasn't being properly cared for or that we were being taken advantage of.

Finally, we went to Dr. Adam Avitan when he was working at a clinic in Richmond. It was clear from the first appointment he's got a head on his shoulders, he knows what he's talking about, and he isn't going to charge us an arm and a leg for something that wasn't necessary.

Paige has since passed, I've adopted two lovely cats, and Dr. Avitan has moved to Juno vet on Main. It was a no-brainer that I would be taking them to him.

Our 2 year old guy has been having some bad breath and when we took him in for his vaccines, Dr. Avitan immediately flagged he had some significant gingivitis and recommended a dental cleaning. A couple days later, they sent me a full detailed pricing breakdown with a high and low estimate. What I think is really unique about Juno is that they tell you what's optional!! They explain WHY they're recommending each thing, but at the end of the day, they're giving you the ALL of the information and letting you decide whats best for you and your pet.

I spent some time shopping around, getting quotes and doing research on other options in the lower mainland. In the end, I decided to spend a couple extra dollars for the peace of mind knowing I trust Dr. Avitan so much. I am so so grateful I did.

We took our Zephyr in yesterday morning. I was greeted by the warm, smiling staff as usual, there was a brief intake where they explained what I should expect, and they whisked him away.

Throughout the day I received text updates, letting me know when the procedure started, how he was doing, etc.. After his x-rays, Dr. Avitan called me to let me know there were 5 teeth that needed to be extracted. He walked me through what they found, what it meant, and the options we had going forward. He answered all my questions with patience and let me know how the extractions would effect the cost (was still within the quote).

A couple of hours later, I picked up Zephyr. Before taking him home, they explained what to expect post-op. Then this morning I received a text from Juno asking how he's doing, how his energy and appetite levels are doing, etc.!! I had to drop everything and write a review so every other nervous pet owner would know that this is absolutely the place for them.

Just last year I fostered a cat from a local rescue who had a full dental extraction due to severe gingivitis and stomatitis while in my care. This was all done through the rescue's vet partner, which was a different clinic in Vancouver. Let me tell you, I was entirely in the dark and especially being a first time cat care-taker, I was absolutely freaked! She ended up needing steroids and antibiotics from a gnarly infection and at no point did I feel like I had a grasp on what was happening, what to look out for, or what to do next. They didn't even allow me in the exam room with the vet so I had to ask the receptionist my questions and she would go to the back, ask the vet, then relay the answer.

So, when Zephyr needed a dental procedure, you can imagine I was expecting the worst. While I wouldn't call the experience enjoyable for obvious reasons, Juno has made this so so so so much easier. Like in ways words can't even express! Thank you Dr. Avitan and the Juno team!!!

These guys are unbelievable. If you haven't switched to Juno yet, do it. They treated my cat, Pizza, with the utmost care, and answered all my questions. The employees also just seem to love animals, and were giving my cat scritches and all the attention he demanded. Also, the clinic itself is clean, and very relaxing. Another bonus is them offering me coffee and sparkling water. I will never take my cats anywhere else!!!

What a great clinic! The space is clean, warm and welcoming. The staff are all wonderful, and  Dr. Avitan is a gem. The pricing is transparent and fair. Very happy to have you guys in the neighbourhood :)
Dr. Alyssa Chrapko was patient and compassionate towards myself and my kitty at a challenging time in our lives.  Thank you for the work you do. 🙏💞😻 …

Had a lovely experience here with my cat. Dr. Ong was extremely thorough with her check up and herself and vet tech were very gentle when handling my very clearly scared cat.
Pricing was extremely transparent and affordable for the tests required. Really feel that all staff really love what they do and strive to bring the best care and attention to pets and their owners as well. I think this will be where we bring our cats from now on. Thank you

The Juno team have been so unbelievably helpful As I navigate the very complicated process of bringing my dog to Australia. They have gone above and beyond, ensuring all the documentation is exactly how it needs to be (usually requiring multiple amendments as it’s a very complicated and specific process).
They have helped coordinate appointments with my dogs carer (I have had to come back to Australia) and I just want to express my appreciation for their amazing communication and help ❤️
Thank you for the 5 star review!
Thank you for the 5 star review! :)

i was interested in taking my cat to juno after we had poor experiences in the past with vets not tending to the specific needs for cats. something that i really appreciate is the details put into everything from the lounge to the exam room - there is a basket and towel for cats to be comfortable in and pheromone hand sanitizer to help relax anxiety for them.

the staff are so sweet and kind and always checking in on us. i like to go to our appointments a little early to have my cat get acclimated to the space and the staff are so accommodating of this every time. my cat loves all of the staff and doctors and she feels safe being around them which is a huge deal if you know how cats can be.

a lot of vet clinics are more dog focused, which is understandable, but juno took great care and thought into potential cat patients and their owners and i can't ever express how much it means to me and our kitty.

if you have a cat companion and have been looking for a vet that will take great care of your needs, i couldn't recommend juno enough :)

Pics below of said companion of mine.
Thank you for the stellar review!

Juno Veterinary on Main Street helped me with my very spicy cat who had a medical emergency two days ago. Vet techs Hudson and Natasha were superstars -- I honestly don't know how I would have gotten Flo the care she needed without their help -- and Dr. Tris was fantastic. Paula on the front desk also went above and beyond. They not only dealt with her urgent issue, but were able to give her a thorough checkup and even trim her nails. I can't recommend them enough and will definitely trust them with all my cat care going forward.

I've had a lovely experience with Juno!  They have been clear, communicative and transparent during my time with them.  I haven't felt pressured for procedures or upsold on anything that felt unnecessary.

My cat Elsie recently got some dental cleaning and she's doing quite well!  It's clear the staff are very attentive and take care of our fur babies!
They're my vet for my cat and dog. The staff are all very nice. I appreciate how communicative they are. The Juno app is great and the speed and quality of the chat team on the app is top notch.

My cat kept sneezing so much that I did not know what to do. I called Juno Vet 30 minutes before they closed for support. They asked me to send a video of his breathing through the chat app, they asked me questions and helped me with what I should do next. I really liked that they were able to support through the info I gave them with videos instead of telling me to go in right away or just booking an appointment. They also gave me some further directions in case my cat developped some specific symtoms. SO helpful!
Everything goes well every time I take my dog for her appointments. There's no stress for her and she always leaves happy! We appreciate everything that the whole team does for us.

My dog and I love Juno, they have been so kind to us and really genuinely care about my dogs health. They know how to distract him with treats and cuddles, making the experience stress free for both of us. They go above and beyond and even drew this little picture of my dog on his take-home bag after he got neutered. Thank you for all you do!!
Dr. Adam helped my cat eye problem! Would recommend!!

The team at Juno Main Street clinic was absolutely phenomenal from start to finish.

The minute we walked in it was clear to see the extent their staff go to ensure a high level of comfort and care is provided. From appointment scheduling, to medications, treatment plan and aftercare it was a clear and stress-free experience.

I highly recommend this location to anyone  looking for a safe space to bring your pets.
The staff at Juno are all lovely and welcoming especially the reception staff. It was a stress free visit as the doctor listened thoroughly and addressed my concerns

The price is ridiculous, a less than 7 minute ear infection follow-up and they charged us $99. They didn’t even ask if we had any concerns or questions at the end, just “ok, that’s for today.” Their marketing and branding feels like brainwashing; nothing about it feels premium, and you can’t even feel the professionalism.

The front desk also seems used to people’s reactions. They don’t even give you a breakdown of the charge, just “ok after taxes is $xxx, charge the card on file?” They don’t care about your pet, it’s just business and money for them. Find somewhere else with ethical care.
Thank you for the 5 stars Rachael!
The team at Juno are so sweet, considerate and wicked smart. I'm very happy to be their neighbour and I trust them with my two cats wholeheartedly.
The Juno Main Street team is so caring about both animals and people, through the good times and the bad they have always been very kind to us

After my Frenchie had bladder surgery at an emergency clinic they suggested prescription food which unfortunately they didnt have for another week. I was told to call around and purchase it at any vet clinic that carries it. Well I called Juno and to my question of do you have the food they said yes but you need to bring the dog here to have an examination and get a membership to be able to purchase food. ( this food can be purchased at any vet clinic btw..unfortunately its a long weekend and many clinics were out) Avoid this place at all cost unless you want to throw your money at people who will make random policies to get paid. This type of establishment shouldn't be operating for animals ...disgusting

I cannot recommend this clinic. I was told my cat had an upper respiratory infection. No medications helped. Four different kinds. Further tests were done. I was told the lump they found after a radiographer looked at it, was trapped poop. Poop was taken out of his colon. I was advised to give him a laxative. Turns out my dear one had colon cancer. Giving a laxative in this situation must have been extremely distressing for him. I spent a lot of money and trusted them as the experts. The reception staff and Dr Kadi are curtious and nice is the only positive thing I can say. I'm not sure much could have been done but it seems like interventions taken at Juno made him feel even worse, which is horrible.

Absolutely atrocious pricing strategy. I understand that vets need to function as a business, but in this case it’s more accurate to say this is a business that happens to offer veterinary services.

When I cancelled my appointment after receiving a significant price increase with no prior notice, I received this condescending little farewell. I guess wanting fair pricing isn’t the demographic of their clientele. As a New Yorker, I definitely could use a lecture on affordability in a ‘big’ city.
Good thing we got that sorted out.

Unfortunately it’s a one star for me, unreasonably priced, 2k for diagnosis of torn ACL only is insane and I don’t think we should be supporting steep hikes in prices like this. Regular vet, not some fancy clinic with fake prices can diagnose your dogs torn ACL for $600-$800.

The price is one thing but what actually made me go with one star is the approach of their vet. The issue happened when we started talking about my dogs food. I told the vet I’m cooking for her and she immediately said that my food isn’t balanced, without even asking WHAT EXACTLY I put in, it’s just not balanced by default. I told her that I know what I’m doing because I did my research and educated myself on how to make a healthy, well balanced food for my dog - to this the lady laughed in my face with an arrogant smirk. This obviously pissed me off so I stopped discussing food, asked them to finish whatever they’re working on and I took my dog to an actual vet.

I can’t say enough good things about this veterinary clinic. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a warm, compassionate team that clearly cares about both pets and their owners. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always willing to take the time to answer questions without making you feel rushed.

Dr. Kadi, my dog Bodhi’s veterinarian, is incredibly knowledgeable and thorough. She explains diagnoses and treatment options in a clear, understandable way, which really helps you feel confident in the care your pet is receiving. It’s obvious Dr. Kadi (and the whole Juno team) treats every animal as if it were their own, with genuine kindness and patience.

The clinic itself is clean, well-organized, and equipped with modern technology, which adds to the sense of trust and professionalism. Scheduling appointments is easy, and they do their best to accommodate urgent situations quickly.

What truly sets this clinic apart is the level of compassion they show—not just during routine visits, but also during more difficult moments. They go above and beyond to ensure both pets and their owners feel supported.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. Your pet will be in great hands.
Made me feel welcomed and looked after as soon as I stepped into the space!  5 stars all the way!
Thet show up with a big surprise on the Bill amount

We have had only pawsitive experiences with our two cats at Juno! Not only did they do a thorough check on our cats, with detailed questions and recommendations, they also gave very detailed breakdowns after our visit for lab results on samples they took for health checks. We have follow up plans to keep our kitties healths in perfect order, and I appreciate the options they provide to give the best results!

the facility is fantastic, coffee and drinks for us and treats for the kiddos!

the staff are so kind, giving lots of love to the kiddos, and even sent them home with gift bags with so many goodies 🥹❤️

too bad I can’t add photos to the review 😭

Had my cat checked first time, I never regret choosing Juno in Main street, the place is so clean and chill, pet-friendly, fur mom's haven, staff is nice and warm, moreso I was surprised on how great the vet is, Dr. Paul Holland, he is attentive, listening, assertive, and really knows what he's doing, you can feel the care and professionalism the way he deals his pet-patients. Treated my cat practically and straight-forward, keep it up Juno vet💕

This place is an absolute CASH GRAB. I’m pretty sure most of the reviews are purchased reviews. The “vet” had absolutely no idea what my dog has, they just care about making money and selling you stuff. If you care about your dog’s health, this is NOT the place to take them. Don’t even waste your time answering 🤡 …
Absolutely amazing team so greatful for their care and professionalism.
Great vet office. Super comfortable, accessible, and friendly. It doesn't feel like a traditional vet office. My dogs love coming here

Felt it was an oversell .The promo is to get you through the door .They displayed a menu of options ranging from 800-1100 $ at the first consultation before they would start  .Thereafter you get bombarded with marketing material .Going back to a single clinic ownership .Just a better fit for us .

Had such a great experience at Vet Clinic Juno! My dog Juno is usually terrified of the vet, but Dr. Pal Holland and RVT Michelle were amazing and took extra time to help her feel comfortable. They were super patient, kind, and really listened to what Juno needed.

The treats were a big win for Juno, and the drinks for us humans were such a nice bonus too. You can tell they genuinely care and want visits to be a good experience for everyone.

Huge thank you—especially to Auntie Treat Lady Michelle—for making a normally stressful visit such a positive one. Would absolutely recommend! 🐾💛
Love this place. It's amazing how the little things make such a difference to vet care. Dr Holland is a fantastic vet and both my cats have been the calmest ever for the checkups here.
Thank you Lisa for the 5 star review!

We’ve been taking Levi here for the past year or so. He really doesn’t like going to the vet or going out at all, but the team at Juno have always been very warm and supportive of him (and cleaning up after his accidents). We’re really thankful that Juno has opened up so close to home and Levi is also very grateful!

I took my two Devon Rex cats here to get all their vaccines and a neuter. The staff are amazing and super helpful with anything and everything. The boys love Dr.Kadi and you can tell all the doctors and techs really have a love for animals. This is one of the only vets I’ve felt 100% comfortable leaving my animals with the cats always return home with toys, photos or treats! They are also transparent with pricing and don’t just stick you with an insane bill. We also love the app and communication through text is perfect especially having questions about the neuter healing process!
Wilfred and Alfie say thank you to all the staff at Juno Main Street!
The whole team at Juno is so attentive, caring, thoughtful and patient. Highly recommend!
Thank you Karan for the 5 star review!
Thank you Josephine for the stellar review!
We appreciate the 5 star review Aksa! :)
Thank you for the great review Savanna! :)
Truly appreciate the amazing review Larissa!

Friendly professional staff.
Cat approves 😊 …

Juno Vet is hands down the best vet clinic I’ve ever been to. From the moment I walked in, it felt like stepping into a spa- for pets and humans alike. The space is warm, modern, and spotless, and the staff? Absolute gems. Everyone was so kind, welcoming, and clearly obsessed with animals in the best way possible. The clinic rooms are pristine, the vibe is calm, and the care is next-level.

They go above and beyond in every single detail -from the way they greet you to the follow-up care afterward. You can tell they truly love what they do and take pride in making both pets and owners feel comfortable. The whole experience was stress-free, smooth, and actually enjoyable. Juno Vet, you’ve officially raised the bar for what vet visits should be!
Thank you so much Gessica! We’re so glad you and Komamura had a great experience with us. - The Juno Veterinary Main Street Team
Great experience every time. Special thanks to Dr. Kadi White for her patience and knowledge throughout our visits - staff at Juno are passionate about their job which creates a great atmosphere.

We had a great experience at Juno Vet! The clinic is super clean and modern, and the overall vibe is so friendly and welcoming. Dr. Adam was amazing with my dog—attentive, thorough, and clearly cares about his patients. He took the time to explain everything and was very transparent about pricing, which I really appreciated. You can tell they genuinely love animals and take pride in providing excellent and genuine care

We brought our cat, Sage, in for her annual exam and blood work. The second we walked in, we were impressed by the level of professionalism that was presented. It was so refreshing to see a vet who truly cares about animals and treats them like family. Sage can be a little shy, but Dr. Kadi's calm and compassionate approach put her completely at ease. She made sure Sage was comfortable during the exam. We left feeling confident and grateful for such wonderful care. We couldn't be happier!
Thank you for the stellar review Ashleigh!
Thank you for the lovely review Steven!

Hi Marianna, 

Thank you so much for your 4-star review! 🐾 We’re happy to hear you and Hemi had a good experience with us. We’d love to know what we can do to make your next visit a 5-star one — your feedback helps us provide the best possible care. 

Warmly, 
The Juno Veterinary Team- Main Street

Bringing my pet to Juno has been such a great experience so far! I’ve had some not-so-great experiences with previous vets/clinics, but Juno has put me at ease. Though pricing can be high (literally costs an arm and a leg anywhere nowadays) I appreciate the communication about pricing and various  options of care. Dr. Paul has been great!! He really listens to concerns and welcomes questions/ open to discuss various options and not JUST vet prescribed diets, medicine, etc (I’ve had vets be very pushy about products they sell and provide no alternate solutions which feels not awesome). Not to mention the clinic is a spotless, calm, and friendly environment (for your pet and yourself ha). I’m an anxious pet owner so this is my love letter.
We absolutely loved our visit. Fantastic staff, relaxing environment and great communication. True 5 star experience.

i recently switched to juno veterinary and I am very pleased with the care and experience. the clinic is beautiful, spacious, and spotless, and every detail about it feels really thoughtful and intentional. it’s such a great space 🐾

the whole team is incredible. they take the time to explain every option and make sure you feel comfortable and informed. everyone I’ve interacted with is kind, easy to talk to, and you can tell they genuinely care about both you and your pets.

i’ve had appointments for my dog and cat Pandora & Wesley with Dr Adam, and pandora recently had an ultrasound at Juno. every visit has been smooth. communication and booking are so easy. couldn’t recommend them more 🩺 the Juno team really will dote on your pets like their own 💚💚

I had a great experience here today! I was very nervous coming in that my concerns wouldn't be taken seriously but everyone was so lovely and the vet was amazing. The staff took everything seriously and ordered tests for my lovely Oliver. All the pricing is very up front and transparent. Excited to be going here now.

I’m beyond impressed with Juno Veterinary Clinic. From the service and communication to the modern space and technology, everything was outstanding. The staff and vet were professional, gracious, and kept me well-informed throughout the visit. The clinic itself is spotless and well-organized, and I really appreciated the large monitor that clearly displayed a detailed, line-item breakdown of the costs—no hidden fees, everything explained thoroughly. Everyone was warm and welcoming, and free parking was easy to find. Overall, it was such a positive experience. My little pup enjoyed it so much he didn’t even want to leave!

I am endlessly grateful to Paula, and the whole Juno Vet for the compassionate care they provided to my beloved cats, Bagheera and Grimm, especially toward the end of their lives. The team was so gentle, patient, and understanding, making sure my cats were comfortable and treated with dignity every step of the way. They not only cared for my cats with the deepest respect, but also supported me through such a painful and emotional time. Their compassion and kindness will never be forgotten, and I truly cannot thank them enough for being there for us when we needed it most. 🐈‍⬛❤️🐈‍⬛

I brought my dog to Juno when it opened as she was starting to experience concerning symptoms. I found everyone there so caring and helpful. The 24/7 chat service was useful when I needed it and I was amazed at the proactive follow up from the client care staff (I built a warm relationship with Nathalia especially), RVTs and my vet, Dr. Paul. They demonstrated genuine concern for my dog. When my dog presented with an eye issue, Sami proactively called ahead to the vet ophthalmologist and made it seamless for me to take my dog in for an emergency visit. Unfortunately, we had to say goodbye to my dog (she was eventually diagnosed with cancer) but I will be forever grateful for the care and support from Juno Main Street.

The BEST vet experience within my 11 years of owning my dog.

I can't even begin to explain how smooth of an experience bringing my 11-year-old anxious dog to the vet was. When we first arrived for our very first appointment with Juno at 10AM, (we arrived 15minutes early just incase we needed to sign papers or anything), we were greeted by the receptionist right away.

The initial atmosphere when entering the clinic was super calming and inviting. The receptionist offered my dog some treats, offered us coffee (from their COFFEE BAR!!) and since we were early, let us into our INDIVIDUAL room ahead of time to get settled. Unlike our previous vet, we would be stuck in a waiting room with multiple other animals who increased the tension and anxiousness of my dog. At the various other clinics I have tried out, Juno was the best at creating an inviting, calming and structured appointment/visit for me and my dog.

The doctors/nurses who helped during our appointment took so much care and paid so much attention to our concerns. They took notes, listened and never cut us off. They gave us a whole look into a treatment plan and costs and when deciding on the treatments we would like to proceed with, we did not feel pressured into pursuing any unecessary treatments at a higher cost. I felt like they truly cared and treated my dog so kindly.

After our appointment, Juno went the extra mile to text us about any updates on my dog and ensured to update us when our information from our previous vet was fully transferred over to their clinic. Communication with Juno is impeccable and has helped to boost my confidence in their practices.

I would definitely recommend you take your animals here if you want a calm, smooth visit to the vet!! AND not to mention, we got a $50 credit on our first visit!! Love Juno <3

I was sold by the way Juno claimed to be transparent about its pricing and also its claim to offer premium vet services - which made the annual membership worth it for me. However my experience there was extremely disappointing: beyond the fancy branding, the free coffee and sparkling water you get, nothing about Juno is premium - including the vet care you get. It’s just another VC-owned vet clinic trying to get as much profit as possible from desperate owners. Please stay away.

The appointment fee is higher than others ($129 consultation) but the vet almost seemed lost and unsure of himself constantly. The 24/7 support they claim you get via the app is also a scam - it’s just the vet techs answering you like a customer service rep from Amazon, you don’t get actual answers. They had a simple task to get back to me about x-rays, and it took a week of continuous follow ups from me before they actually called me back because I threatened to cancel my membership.

As we all know, vet care in Vancouver is overall terrible and over priced  and sadly Juno is just another one of those clinics contributing to the sad state of the vet industry here. Owners - save your money and look elsewhere.
Thank you for the stellar review!

Took our kitten in for his booster vaccines! I was a little nervous with coming to a new vet and what that process would look like, but Dr. Esther and her vet tech were so patient, kind, and explained everything to ensure we got Morrie set up for the next 20 years!! The space is so clean and comfortable, making the entire experience stress free! The worst part of the trip for Morrie was the car ride lol

I had a wonderful experience with Juno Veterinary Main Street for my Yorkie. From the start, the team was warm, responsive, and incredibly professional. They provided a very detailed explanation of the dental procedure and took the time to address all my concerns with care and patience.

The staff truly made me feel supported, and it was clear they had Chocolate’s best interests at heart. I especially appreciated their compassionate communication and the thoughtful way they approach pet care.

A big thank you to Paula and the team — your kindness and professionalism really stood out. Highly recommend Juno to any pet parent looking for a clinic that genuinely cares!
Hi Kate, thank you for your rating! We’d love to hear any feedback you might have so we can make Sadie’s next visit even better. We look forward to seeing you both again soon! 💚 …
They really cared for my dog when he was having some trouble. Suggested i take him to the ER, which was most definitely the right choice. Great service by all the people at Juno.
Thank you for the review Gabriela!

We paid our annual fee and brought our kitten for shots, and had to come back for second and third round. When the staff sent us the quote I noticed they charge $129 consultation fee every single time. Kitten shots are only 1-2 weeks apart. I found this unfair so I spoke to the staff and they told me it was a fee for the vet to check the heart, teeth etc. They really only do a quick check so it felt like a money grab when we had been there the week before.
I decided to move to a different vet who waives the consultation fee every time. They charge it only once a year and the vet has many more years of experience.

I can’t say enough about our family’s experience at Juno on Main St.

The entire staff make the effort and get to know you and your pet.
The care and the services they provide were excellent. We were never rushed and the care providers literally are on the floor with your pet. I was surprised by the very reasonable prices. There are no surprises. All costs and options are presented in the tv screen in the room so you can make financial decisions.
The pdf reports on  tests and the summary of the visit from the vet is amazing.  You will receive that by email. I wish I got that much detail from my own doctor / Life Labs.

The facility is very nice. From the waiting areas to the “patient” rooms. It doesn’t feel, or smell, like a normal vet at all.

The difference maker is the communication and access to someone through their app. Open a Chat on the app and I was connected to someone in one minute who could review my pets file, check for an appointment opening, provide advice and answer any questions I had.

We had to say goodbye to our pet. 😭
The Juno staff were amazing.
To find a card and flowers at my home days later ❤️ wow
I am so grateful I took a chance on Juno and I will not hesitate to continue to use Juno for our next pet.
My sincere thank you to Dr Adam, Dr Paul and all the staff who provided excellent care and communication.
Great staff, great facility.
Boris appreciated it

We had a fantastic experience here with our pug, who is usually quite anxious at the vet. Dr. Kadi was absolutely amazing with him—so calm, patient, and kind. The clinic itself is beautiful, clean, and welcoming. The staff were all lovely and made us feel comfortable right away. We really appreciated how upfront they were about pricing, with no surprises. And the goodie bag at our first visit was such a thoughtful touch! Highly recommend Juno to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares.
Staff is so friendly, and space is clean and organized. Nathalia from reception gave us a tour and showed the facility. This boosted our confidence!
Thanks for the 5 star review Marilia!

We had such a wonderful experience at Juno Vet! My dog Beru is a rescue and tends to be quite fearful, but the staff went above and beyond to make both of us feel at ease. From the moment we walked in, everyone was kind, patient, and communicative—not just with me, but with Beru too.

What really stood out was how transparent they were with pricing and how thoroughly they answered all my questions. It made everything feel clear and stress-free. Beru even got some tasty treats, a cute bandana, and we were sent home with a tote bag full of goodies—and yes, they even had snacks for the humans!

I truly appreciate how thoughtful and professional the whole team was. It’s not easy finding a vet clinic that understands fearful dogs, but Juno Vet nailed it. Highly recommend to any fellow pet parent! 🐾

Amazing staff, both extremely friendly and knowledgable. The atmosphere of their clinic is welcoming and playful, completely unique from other clinics I've been to. They are high tech, clean, and I feel they care about not only my pet's health, but her happiness and comfort as she ages. I foresee a future where she is not scared of vet visits and instead is excited to see her friends at juno to get treats and be fawned over for her cuteness.

My beloved dog Lucky went to get his vaccinations today. I also consulted the vet about his slightly bloodshot eyes and tendency to get ear infections. They were very caring and attentive, which was a huge relief.
The clinic itself is very clean, and both the doctor and the nurses are incredibly friendly.
This is a trustworthy veterinary clinic that I can rely on to take care of my precious family member’s health.
I’ve been to many different veterinary clinics, but this one is by far the best. I highly recommend it!
Thank you, Team Juno Vet!

The best veterinary experience we've had in 11 years — truly life-changing.

From the moment I reached out via email, Nathalia at reception went above and beyond with warmth, clarity, and care. She guided us through every step, from pre-visit medication instructions to thoughtful support at check-out. Her kindness set the tone for everything that followed.

Dr. Adam Avitan and Amy, RVT, were absolutely extraordinary. They didn’t just perform an exam, they took the time to connect with us and truly understand Firu’s complex history of pain, reactivity, and fear. Their calm, grounded energy immediately made us feel safe. They listened carefully, asked thoughtful questions, and showed sincere empathy throughout the visit.

You can feel Dr. Adam’s deep experience and compassion when it comes to managing chronic pain in senior patients. He explained every treatment option with clarity and patience. I finally felt like my 11-year-old baby was in the hands of someone who truly understands how to manage severe pain... safely, holistically, and with heart.

Amy, was equally amazing, skilled and gentle. Thanks to the support and the fear-free approach of the whole team (lick mats, treats, and lots of patience), Firu was able to complete his full physical exam, bloodwork, etc, all without the need for general anesthesia. That was a first in his entire life, and it meant the world to us.

They also brought Firu up to date on all his vaccines.

I left not just feeling grateful, but truly impressed by the thoroughness, care, and transparency of their practice.

Another major highlight: pricing is fully transparent. Every step was explained ahead of time, with no surprises, and that gave us so much peace of mind.

The clinic is beautifully run, from the app and digital tools, to the membership options, calm environment, and thoughtful in-person care. My sister’s dog here too and were equally happy! We’re so lucky to be part of the Juno community now.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart to the entire team for treating Firu with genuine compassion and love, not just as a difficult dog but instead as a sweet boy who needs kindness, patience and real care 💛🐾

Definitely recommend!
They're were so sweet and kind to my kitty. He's an anxious boy and while definitely still not happy, he was the most chill I've ever seen him at the vet.
Super up front with costs and willing to work with you on it. Only thing I wish, that you could pick up vet food at the store to save on the shipping cost, but that's a minor issue I have.
Definitely helps there's drinks for the humans and snacks for the fur babies, lol.

Was weighing the pros and cons of different Veterinary clinics in Vancouver, Juno being among the top three choices on my list. Recognizing that the staff are certified is admirable to build trust that the organization is prioritizing my pet's health. Ultimately I was swayed by another clinic in Vancouver that still acknowledged the certified credentials with a similar pricing strategy and even waived my first exam. This mindset might not work for everyone, I just like to do my research before choosing a clinic.

Perhaps if Juno ever changes their policies to include some of their basic services in the annual fee I might explore their services in the future, but charging a membership fee that doesn't even cover the cost of the cost of the exam just doesn't sit well with me.

We were making an appointment online and filled out the forms and was given what seems like a mandantory $50 a year membership signup. I consider this a relatively predatory business practice in terms of convincing a customer to join and pay before even getting a service just because they have already done the paperwork. As a business practice I don't condone this.

Hopefully in the future they can adjust this so it feels like a customer first experience rather than a cash grab.
staff are awesome both reception and doctors, transparent pricing, very nice atmosphere to visit. highly recommend Juno after trying 3 other clinics around van the past few years
Amazing staff and well equipped vet clinic! User friendly booking system makes the experience even better. If you are looking for a new veterinarian for your pet, I highly recommend Juno.
Thank you for making our first visit such a lovely experience!

Such a wonderful experience from start to finish. Everyone at Juno goes above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. Not only are they transparent with pricing and treatment plans, but they are warm, loving, and extremely accommodating. Highly recommend to anyone.

Thank you for taking such good care of my baby, coco :)
Our dog loves Juno! Everyone there is super friendly and really cares about your pet. They always make visits easy and stress free for our anxious husky!

I made an appointment the next Monday on a Friday for my senior cat because she wasn't eating , almost immediately they sent me a message referring me to the emergency  hospital because waiting until Monday would cause pancreatitis. Resulted that my cat has a serious condition , kidney decease among others, the prognosis was euthanasia. However  I kept the appointment with Juno The next Monday, the opening day, and they treated my senior lady with so much love and compassion, they also understood our situation and gave us instructions for improving my cats life quality. She has been very good so far and I can't thank them enough for giving her a chance to improve her last days, she is not suffering at all. Last but not least the prices are affordable and  they always calculate everything before requesting your approval. The service and the app is user friendly and practical. As we were one of their first clients they gave us a tote bag and cat toys that my cat enjoyed.
Edit: My cat didn't  die after a few days, she has been improving following the indications given by our vet at Juno, it has been one month and now we will go back every month for monitoring and refills. I can't give them 1000 stars ✨ but they deserve those stars. Look at my baby feeling comfortable and relaxed at the clinic.

I can’t say enough good things about Juno Veterinary Clinic in Vancouver! What a beautiful clinic! The staff, location and services are top-notch and the space itself is very welcoming for patients both 4 and 2 legged. Definitely a class above your standard vet visit experience.

Thanks for the 5 star stellar review Steph! Looking forward to your next happy visit with your cute pup! You are welcome to pop by anytime with your cute puppy and take a little treat bag (from our treat bar) for your walk. :) 

We love creating positive experiences for our furry friends!
Thank you for the 5 star review Germana! We are happy to here you had a positive visit at Juno!
Juno always delivers such incredible service - from quality of care to follow-up. I trust that my dog is well taken care of!

So happy I found Juno!
The team was super friendly and knowledgeable — they answered all my questions as my dog is a sensitive tummy kind of dog.

I had a great experience bringing my puppy Toffee to Juno Main St! I love everything about the way they do business.
I had a poor experience with another vet clinic in Vancouver and comparing them to Juno is night and day.
The staff are incredible. Super friendly, knowledgeable, and they all seem to love what they do.
I cannot recommend them enough.
Staff are professional and respectful! Will recommend!
